text:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy check for rc-2026-07-01-3 on canary-eu1 completed. Healthcheck-scan reported p99 +320ms and a 2.4% increase in synthetic cache-miss rate. Starting triage. Tagging #eng-releases :warning:

jen: noticed the alert. is this the new packing build (pack-int8-13b) that went out?

rohit: yes. quick glance at traces: a minority of prefills show unexpected trailing whitespace tokens ("\n ") which push sequences into a slower decode path.

qa-z: repro locally with tight loop shows tail latency spikes. repro command: `for i in $(seq 1 400); do curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/check -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'; done`

pm-alyssa: we just started a release window. what's the risk if we let the rollout continue vs pause?

sre-luca: risk is user-facing tail latency at p99 if this propagates. Options: 1) rollback the canary now 2) pin user-facing route to previous model version and keep canary for telemetry 3) divert synthetic probes while keeping rollout.

jen: prefer option 2. pinning keeps customer traffic on the stable variant and lets us investigate without a full rollback.

rohit: I can apply a route pin for the next 6 hours: route user->model=rc-2026-06-28-2 (pin-id pin-user-4100). That will keep canary live for telemetry but freeze user lanes.

pm-alyssa: agree. also update the release notes and notify the change-window attendees. add a short note in the release draft: "Hold: pinning user route due to post-deploy healthcheck drift; investigating tokenizer whitespace edge-case."

deploy-bot: Applied pin pin-user-4100 -> rc-2026-06-28-2 for routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Pin TTL=6h.

qa-z: after pin, synthetic p99 still spikes on canary traces but user-visible metrics remain at baseline. :white_check_mark:

sre-luca: good. open a follow-up ticket and schedule a hotfix in the next 4-hour change window. include repro, sampled traces, and perf counters.

jen: ticket INF-2026-400 created. Summary: int8 pack prefiller emitting trailing whitespace tokens causing decode slowpath and p99 tail latency. Owner: rohit.

rohit: I'll add a sanitizer in tokenizer and a debounce in fallback kernels. I'll target a patch and canary redeploy in the 4h window.

pm-alyssa: I updated the release draft and alerted stakeholders. Add a line to release notes: "Paused ramp: pinned user routes; canary retained for telemetry; fix targeted in upcoming hotfix window."

sre-luca: decision recap: rollout paused for user traffic via pin, canary remains for debugging, ticket INF-2026-400 created, hotfix scheduled in change window +4h. Keep synthetic probes diverted from user lanes.

jen: thanks all. Will monitor traces and reopen rollout once fix verified. :thumbsup:
